title: MiniMax H3 Character Swap 1.5 | SAM3.1 VDN8 [Workflows/Other]
description:
MiniMax H3 Character Swap 1.5 is a ComfyUI workflow for replacing one tracked character in a source video with a new character defined by a reference image. SAM 3.1 tracks the target, the workflow cleans and maps the mask into the generation latent, and the edited subject is composited back into the source frames. The connected generation path uses MiniMax H3 Ref2VA, the h3_character_swap_v1.5 LoRA at strength 1.0, and OpenVDN DMD8 at 8 NFE.

Main features:
- SAM 3.1 video tracking, mask cleanup, dynamic subject crop, and local subject recompositing.
- MiniMax H3 video and audio latent path with the Character Swap 1.5 LoRA.
- OpenVDN/vdn-minimax-h3 stage_dmd_8nfe execution plan. This is a single-stage 8 NFE workflow; it does not include a second 4 NFE refinement or 2x upscale pa
